versions.changelog: Fix ~2.6x over-count: switch source from *.trajectory.jsonl (which emits multiple events per LLM call, each carrying the same usage snapshot) to canonical session *.jsonl (type=message, role=assistant). Add --tz utc|local (default utc, aligns with pew). Pew's 86.9M vs old 229M for the same day was caused by this bug.
Docs: use absolute GitHub raw URLs for screenshots so they render on ClawHub.
Docs: add header button and modal screenshots.
Merge agent-token-usage-ui into this skill. Optional 📊 button via apply-ui.sh. Old agent-token-usage-ui slug is deprecated.
Initial release: per-agent daily LLM token consumption from OpenClaw trajectory files, with billable-equivalent estimate
